name: Webflow
summary: A crisp light product-tool style with white canvas, near-black text, cool gray borders, one vivid blue accent, weight-600 display type, and realistic browser-frame product mockups.

webflowBlue.role: Primary actions, active navigation, links, emphasis

mercuryTint.role: Alternating bands and subtle neutral backgrounds

typography.fallbackStack: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

components.nav: Sticky white top bar, 56px tall, blue wordmark or logo, simple links, primary CTA.
components.hero: Centered text stack on white with display headline, muted subtext, primary CTA, and product-card row.
components.productMockup: Realistic browser chrome around product UI, using shadow to create display depth.
components.featureCard: White card, 1px gray border, 8px radius, 24px padding, optional hover shadow.
components.cookieBanner: Fixed bottom-left white box, 380px max-width, 1px gray border, 8px radius, stacked buttons.
components.logoStrip: Monochrome customer logos on white or tinted background.
components.badge: 4px radius blue badge with uppercase white text.

dos: Use #146ef5 as the only interactive accent.
Set hero headlines large, tight, and weight 600.
Use 8px radius for cards and large containers.
Use product UI inside browser chrome.
donts: Do not add extra chromatic UI colors.
Do not make hero display type light or small.
Do not mix in serif or decorative fonts.
Do not place blue hover states directly on dark surfaces.
